title: The Homotopy 3-Type of Abelian C*-Algebras
summary: We compute the homotopy groups at each unital abelian C*-algebra $C(T)$ in the Morita $3$-category of abelian C*-algebras, C*-algebras with central maps, C*-correspondences, and adjointable bimodule maps. We describe these groups in terms of the topological data of the underlying compact Hausdorff space $T$. We also compute the actions of the first homotopy group on the second and third homotopy groups in terms of these topological invariants of $T$.
